proof_body:
by
  intro a b m n
  simp only [Nat.modEq_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have := Int.coe_lcm_dvd (a := (m : ℤ)) (b := (n : ℤ)) h1 h2
    simpa [Int.lcm] using this
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)).trans h, (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (Nat.dvd_lcm_right m n)).trans h⟩
target_source: ∀ a b m n : ℕ, (a ≡ b [MOD m] ∧ a ≡ b [MOD n]) ↔ a ≡ b [MOD Nat.lcm m n]
